description:
This video explores how digital representations, specifically digital twins, shape real-world power. It examines the connection between modeled systems and their real-world counterparts, and how this connection enables prediction, optimization, and control. The video discusses the implications of digital twins on authority, visibility, and control, and how they redistribute civic authority. It also delves into the issues of data ownership, governance, and the environmental and security costs associated with digital twins.

title: How Digital Twins Shape Real-World Power: Data, Governance, and Control
